# Thanatos-7 provenance

Original public Thanatos-7 Zombie Plague package downloaded from the source post:

- Forum: https://zppv.boards.net/thread/992/zp-thanatos-7
- Source archive page: https://www.mediafire.com/download/1fvalo563czqsbx/source.rar
- Resources archive page: https://www.mediafire.com/download/locqvze4t1346pt/Thanatos+-+7.rar

Included here: original `zp_extra_thanatos7.sma` and precompiled `.amxx`, four GoldSrc models, ten weapon sounds, four HUD sprites, and `weapon_thanatos7.txt`. The forum post does not state a license; author credit is retained (`Dev!l`).
